title: Cinnamon Chocolate Pots
blurb: Rich, set chocolate custards with a warm hint of cinnamon, cooked gently on the hob and chilled until firm.
steps: Break the chocolate into pieces and place in a heatproof bowl.
Warm the milk in a saucepan over a medium heat until it just begins to steam, then pour it over the chocolate and stir until melted and smooth.
Whisk the eggs, sugar, cinnamon and salt together in a separate bowl until combined.
Pour the chocolate mixture into the egg mixture, whisking constantly until smooth.
Divide the mixture between six small ramekins or cups.
Place the ramekins in a large, deep frying pan and pour boiling water around them until it reaches halfway up their sides.
Cover the pan with a lid or foil and simmer gently for 8 to 10 minutes until the custards are just set but still have a slight wobble in the centre.
Remove the ramekins from the water, leave to cool, then chill in the fridge for at least 2 hours before serving.
